name: Yume Biyori
source:
After a certain incident, Miru, Shino, and Yura had a falling out and drifted apart.
Still unable to reconcile, they reunited at the funeral of their other childhood friend, Haru, who died of illness.

Amidst this, the devilish magician Terese stopped time with her mischief.
The three are asked by the catperson magician Anya to become magical girls and fight to defeat Therese.

What is the truth behind this magical power...?
What is Therese's purpose...?

A sparkling fantasy tale woven with cute magic and deep friendship.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6483]Novelgame[/url]]
